vector<ll> a(18);
ll answer = INF;

ll compute(ll m, int index);

    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> n;

    a[0] = 1;

        a[i] = a[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
    }
